title: Mirror-quintic periods, modular-type structures, and a conifold obstruction
exact_target: Determine modular or automorphic structures for the mirror-quintic period series and the other Picard–Fuchs solutions.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath, record 20002513 (AIM-PHYSICS-0021). Catalogue curation under CC BY 4.0; definitions and English exposition added locally.
American Institute of Mathematics, Gromov-Witten invariants and number theory, source item 4.4.

status_qualification: The Picard–Fuchs equation identifies the series without claiming a classical modular uniformization. The source asks about nonholomorphic forms and other automorphic objects as well as the distinguished period; all are retained. The catalogue title/status was paired with a machine-generated research attempt; that attempt is not peer-reviewed evidence of settlement. The statement covers the original source questions rather than only the title’s subcase.
